title: A diagnostic read that touches item ids names the item_refs join for public refs, on success and on failure.
form: CLI warning, refusal text and packet note
verification: Focused disposable-database tests in runtime/api/domain/handlers/test_db_read.py cover the item_refs_not_joined warning for a *item_id column, its absence when the query already joins item_refs, the same line on a failed read, and packet notes that lead with item_refs for tables carrying item ids. No deployed run proof yet.
